text.p: Livent Inc said on Monday it would issue an unspecified number of common shares in the Canadian securities market.
The entertainment industry newspaper Variety said today the issue was worth C$20 million. Livent confirmed the issue, but declined comment on its size.
Livent said the shares would not be resgistered for sale in the United States.
It said the underwriting syndicate included CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, First Marathon Securities Ltd and Deacon Capital Corp.
Net proceeds of the offering would be used to fund expanding production activities.
Livent said last week that it bought the rights to the works of Dr Seuss and was creating a musical based on them called "The Seussical"
